messages:
zoe-docs: FYI opened PR #4330 to update Private deploy migration guide. changed SDK snippet to show KMS usage and added a short terraform example. asking for quick legal/security check before merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4330
kevin-eng: noted. i'll skim for API name mismatches. also saw CI failing for a broken relative link to /dedicated/legacy-config. tagging ci-bot.
zoe-docs: snippet (sanitized) pasted: ```yaml
kms_arn: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:987654321000:key/abcd-EXAMPLE
endpoint: https://private.redwood.internal
```
ben-legal: please don't include real-looking ARNs. open a redaction ticket and replace with a clearly synthetic value such as arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:012345678901:key/EXAMPLE or <REDACTED_KMS_ARN>. we need a short audit note in the ticket.
omar-security: i'll run a quick branch scan for account numbers/ARNS and attach results to the ticket. also recommend replacing account portion with 012345678901.
ci-bot: docs-preview: linkcheck failed  1 broken link: /dedicated/legacy-config referenced from migration-guide.md: line 92. full log: https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/4330/logs/linkcheck
kevin-eng: small fix pushed for the broken anchor and normalized the fenced block to ```yaml to avoid render quirks. please re-run preview.
zoe-docs: opened REDACT-318 and added original snippet + branch link: https://tracker.internal.redwood/REDACT-318. tagged @ben-legal and @omar-security.
ben-legal: ack. i'll review REDACT-318 now. if this was fabricated we can approve quickly after replacement; if customer-sourced we'll need written permission and a short disclosure entry.
omar-security: branch scan attached to REDACT-318  found a second ARN-like string in examples/terraform/main.tf. recommend sweeping examples dir before merge.
kevin-eng: removed the terraform example, replaced with synthetic placeholder, and updated the SDK field name from kms_arn to kms_key_arn to match client. pushed changes.
ci-bot: docs-preview: rerun queued for PR #4330. status: linkcheck in progress.
ben-legal: REDACT-318 closed  confirmed synthetic replacements and notes added for audit. cleared for merge from legal.
omar-security: scrub complete  no remaining suspicious patterns. attached final report to REDACT-318.
ci-bot: docs-preview: all checks passed for PR #4330.
github: PR #4330  Zoe-docs updated migration-guide.md (branch: docs/private-kms-example). Status: checks passed, awaiting code review approvals. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4330
tara-release: release window for Private docs refresh closes tomorrow 14:00 PT. if this is needed in the next patch, we need approvals and merge before 12:30 PT.
kevin-eng: reviewed and approved. @zoe-docs can you add a changelog note and mention REDACT-318 in the PR?
zoe-docs: done, added CHANGELOG entry and linked REDACT-318, marked PR "hold until CI" initially but now removing hold. merging once another reviewer clicks approve. thanks everyone. :rocket:
